findings.why_it_matters: The wrapped second line of the B-XOR meaning cell was split out of the table: the table row ends at 'boolean exclusive' and 'disjunction)' stands as a detached paragraph between the binary and unary boolean operator tables.

Superscripts were flattened, so the range bounds read as the numbers '10–999', '101000' and '10968' instead of 10 to the power -999 and 10 to the power 1000 minus 10 to the power 968. The parenthesised E-notation still carries the right values, but the leading expression states a wrong magnitude.
